title: 1 February 1964: Live: Olympia Theatre, Paris
content:
February 1964 was the month that The Beatles conquered America and began the British Invasion. It began, however, just as January ended, with two more shows in Paris for the group’s 18-day residency at the Olympia Theatre.

The Beatles’ setlist contained eight songs: ‘From Me To You’, ‘Roll Over Beethoven’, ‘She Loves You’, ‘This Boy’, ‘Boys’, ‘I Want To Hold Your Hand’, ‘Twist And Shout’ and ‘Long Tall Sally’.

Page last updated: 24 January 2024

  • 1970: Ringo and Maureen fly to New York from Los Angeles
  • 1969: Allen Klein discusses The Beatles’ purchase of NEMS
  • 1968: Ringo Starr rehearses for Cilla Black’s television show
  • 1967: Recording: Sgt Pepper’s Lonely Hearts Club Band
  • 1965: US EP release: 4 By The Beatles
  • 1963: The Beatles live: Assembly Rooms, Tamworth
  • 1963: The Beatles live: Maney Hall, Sutton Coldfield
  • 1962: The Beatles live: Thistle Cafe, West Kirby
  • 1962: The Beatles live: Cavern Club, Liverpool (lunchtime)
  • 1961: The Beatles live: Hambleton Hall, Liverpool
